boards.title: Your First Weekend at Nazareth University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key first-weekend route through named campus landmarks, study spaces, recreation, and arts venues.

cards.title: Start at Palladoro Welcome Vista
cards.subtitle: Arrival point on the Nazareth campus map
cards.notes: Use the named welcome vista as a meeting point, then orient yourself with the campus map before choosing the next stop.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a named campus arrival landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth’s campus map labels Palladoro Welcome Vista.
cards.access_notes: Consult the campus map for routes and visitor parking guidance.

cards.title: Locate Clock Tower Commons
cards.subtitle: Named campus landmark and computer-lab building
cards.notes: Make this your visual anchor for the weekend; it is map-listed, and some computer labs there are open around the clock.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable landmark for learning the campus layout.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth lists Clock Tower Commons on its campus map and says some computer labs there are open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Some Clock Tower Commons computer labs are open 24 hours; verify the specific lab before going.

cards.title: Settle into Wilmot Library
cards.subtitle: Campus study areas, movies, and research materials
cards.notes: Take a quiet reset in the library and identify a study area you can return to when classes begin next week.
cards.short_summary: Choose a dependable study-space stop early.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth identifies Wilmot Library as having study areas, movies, and research materials.
cards.access_notes: A NazCard is required for library access.

cards.title: Learn the tunnel route
cards.subtitle: Links Golisano, Shults, Smyth, the Library, and residence areas
cards.notes: Walk a short section of the mapped tunnels so you know a weather-protected route between major academic and student spaces.
cards.short_summary: Practice a practical indoor campus connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth’s Tunnel Walking Map shows tunnels connecting Golisano Academic Center, Shults, Smyth Hall, the Library, and other buildings.
cards.access_notes: Follow posted campus access rules and use the map to plan your route.

cards.title: Get your bearings at Shults Center
cards.subtitle: Student gathering place with Student Experience offices
cards.notes: Stop by the information desk, locate Student Engagement and Leadership, and note the fitness and dining services housed here.
cards.short_summary: Find key student services in one building.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth describes Shults Center as a student gathering place with fitness facilities and Student Experience offices.
cards.access_notes: The building lists daily hours of 7 a.m.–midnight; individual facilities may have different hours.

cards.title: Take a look at Golisano Training Center
cards.subtitle: Indoor track, courts, training facilities, and fitness center
cards.notes: Walk through the facility and note where its indoor track, courts, fitness center, and recreation opportunities are located.
cards.short_summary: Preview a campus recreation and wellness facility.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth says Golisano Training Center includes an indoor track, field, courts, training facilities, cafe, fitness center, and recreation opportunities.
cards.access_notes: Fitness facilities are available to students with a NazCard; check facility-specific hours.

cards.title: Walk the outdoor track
cards.subtitle: Golden Flyer Stadium athletic area
cards.notes: If you are part of the Naz community, use the outdoor track for a daylight walk and get familiar with the stadium side of campus.
cards.short_summary: A simple outdoor movement stop on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth states that the outdoor track is open to the Naz community and publishes stadium hours for athletes.
cards.access_notes: The outdoor track is open to the Naz community; stadium athlete hours are Mon–Thu 8 a.m.–10 p.m., Fri 8 a.m.–8 p.m., and weekends noon–4 p.m.

cards.title: See what is showing at Arts Center Gallery
cards.subtitle: Nazareth Arts Center
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition and spend time with a few works; use the gallery’s posted schedule before making the walk over.
cards.short_summary: Make room for a campus visual-arts visit.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth’s Arts Center Gallery presents diverse artwork and lists Friday and Saturday hours of noon–8 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Posted regular hours are Sun noon–5 p.m., Tue–Thu noon–5 p.m., and Fri–Sat noon–8 p.m.; specific shows may differ.

cards.title: Continue upstairs to Colacino Gallery
cards.subtitle: Second floor of the Arts Center, Art and Design wing
cards.notes: Pair this with the Arts Center Gallery visit and look for the current exhibition in the second-floor Art and Design wing.
cards.short_summary: A second, clearly located campus gallery stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth says the Margaret Colacino Gallery is on the Arts Center’s second floor and serves students and the greater Rochester community.
cards.access_notes: Posted regular hours are Wednesday–Sunday, noon–5 p.m.; confirm exhibition-specific hours first.

cards.title: End at Glazer Music Performance Center
cards.subtitle: 550-seat performance hall and education center
cards.notes: Find the performance center while daylight remains, then check the Arts Center calendar for a future public performance that fits your schedule.
cards.short_summary: Finish by locating a major campus performance venue.
cards.evidence_claim: Nazareth identifies Glazer Music Performance Center as a 550-seat performance hall and education center that opened in 2018.
cards.access_notes: Performance availability and ticketing vary by event; consult the Arts Center calendar before attending.
